sections.heading: Bandwidth ordering
sections.text: Inner current loop (dq): f_ci ~ fsw/10. Neutral-point balancing loop: f_np ~ 5-10x faster than the voltage loop. Outer voltage loop: f_cv = 10-20 Hz (below 2*f_line for three-phase, i.e., below ~120 Hz for 50 Hz grid).

sections.heading: Current loop tuning
sections.text: The dq current loops are decoupled with feedforward. Set kp for the desired crossover: kp ~ 2*pi*f_ci*L_boost/Vdc. The d-axis and q-axis plants are identical after decoupling. Add ki for zero steady-state error.

sections.heading: Neutral-point balancing
sections.text: The neutral-point voltage balance loop adjusts the common-mode duty-cycle offset. Gain should be high enough to correct imbalance within 10-20 line cycles. Too high gain causes audible noise from the capacitors.

sections.heading: Voltage loop tuning
sections.text: The voltage loop regulates the total DC-link voltage. kp ~ 2*pi*f_cv*C_dc/Vdc. ki ~ kp*f_cv/5. The voltage loop output is the current amplitude reference for the d-axis current loop.
